pairs: Et apprehendent septem mulieres virum unum in die illa,
And seven women will take hold of one man,
dicentes:
in that day,
Panem nostrum comedemus,
saying,
et vestimentis nostris operiemur:
“We will eat our own bread and wear our own clothing,
tantummodo invocetur nomen tuum super nos;
only let us be called by your name,
aufer opprobrium nostrum.
so as to take away our reproach.”
In die illa,
In that day,
erit germen Domini in magnificentia et gloria,
the seedling of the Lord will have magnificence and glory,
et fructus terræ sublimis, et exsultatio his qui salvati fuerint de Israël.
and the fruit of the earth will be greatly-esteemed and a source of joy to those who will have been saved out of Israel.
Et erit:
And this shall be:
omnis qui relictus fuerit in Sion,
all who are left behind in Zion,
et residuus in Jerusalem,
and who remain in Jerusalem,
Sanctus vocabitur,
shall be called holy,
omnis qui scriptus est in vita in Jerusalem.
all who have been written in life in Jerusalem.
Si abluerit Dominus sordes filiarum Sion,
Then the Lord will have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion,
et sanguinem Jerusalem laverit de medio ejus,
and will have washed away the blood of Jerusalem from its midst,
in spiritu judicii,
by means of a spirit of judgment
et spiritu ardoris.
and a spirit of intense devotion.
Et creabit Dominus super omnem locum montis Sion, et ubi invocatus est,
And the Lord will create, over every place of Mount Zion and wherever he is called upon,
nubem per diem et fumum, et splendorem ignis flammantis in nocte:
a cloud by day and a smoke with the splendor of burning fire by night.
super omnem enim gloriam protectio.
For protection will be over every glory.
Et tabernaculum erit in umbraculum,
And there will be a tabernacle for shade from the heat in daytime,
diei ab æstu,
and for security,
et in securitatem et absconsionem a turbine et a pluvia.
and for protection from the whirlwind and from rain.
